summary: Selects a two-mode operation state on the object based on the input flag a2. With a2 zero it resets mode (this+0x28) to 1 and clears both selector flags (this+0x2C, this+0x30). With a2 non-zero it transitions mode to 2 and sets both flags to 1, but only when the mode is not already 2. Every path then dispatches through ConditionalDispatch_55e0 and returns its result.

operations.description: Branch on the input flag a2: non-zero takes the active mode path, zero takes the reset path.
Transition to mode 2 only when the current mode at this+0x28 is not already 2.
On the active path set the mode at this+0x28 to 2 and both selector flags (this+0x2C, this+0x30) to 1.
Dispatch through ConditionalDispatch_55e0 after the mode-2 transition and return its result.
On the reset path (a2 == 0) set the mode at this+0x28 to 1 and both selector flags (this+0x2C, this+0x30) to 0.
Dispatch through ConditionalDispatch_55e0 on the reset and redundant-mode paths; its return value is returned to the caller.

unresolved: The exact mode meanings chosen inside ConditionalDispatch_55e0 and the purpose of the two selector flags (this+0x2C, this+0x30) are not established here.
The semantics of the a2 flag (active vs reset) are derived from the call context and are not independently proven.
